topics.label: Soccer gamestate (GCD source)
topics.description: Source of truth for live soccer game-state in staging — published by Trading on AWS MSK (eu-west-1). The GCD Kafka→Pulsar sink connector reads from here and mirrors to Pulsar `game-state`. Payload: protobuf (gamestate outbound API).

topics.label: Live mappings (Kafka→Pulsar)
topics.description: ID/RAMP mapping events between sportsbook IDs and provider IDs, published by the MFSL livedata pipeline on the UKI internal Kafka. GCD's Kafka→Pulsar connector mirrors this to Pulsar `livedata-mappings`. Payload: protobuf (RCP's `MappingDeserializer`); appears as hex/lossy UTF-8 here until the mapping `.proto` is bundled.

topics.label: Mappings discovery (Pulsar→Kafka)
topics.description: Discovery feed of newly observed mappings — Pulsar→Kafka direction. Generated by GCD Pulsar (`mappings-discovery` topic) and pushed back to MFSL Kafka by the euw1 outbound connector. Used by downstream consumers to learn about new IDs.

topics.label: Soccer gamestate (as RCP staging reads it)
topics.description: Same soccer game-state topic name as MSK PRD, but on the US `use2-event-streaming` cluster — this is what the deployed RCP staging service actually consumes (per `sb-rcpfd-infra/ansible/.../vars/stg.yml`). The topic name says `prd.sgt` intentionally: RCP STG consumes prod-shaped data via a US mirror. Compare against MSK and Pulsar to see replication drift. Payload: protobuf.

topics.label: Live mappings (as RCP staging reads it)
topics.description: Live ID/RAMP mappings on the US `use2-event-streaming` cluster — what the deployed RCP staging service consumes (mirrored from MFSL UKI). Use to verify the US mirror is up-to-date with the UKI source. Payload: protobuf.

topics.label: Competition pre-match stats
topics.description: Competition-level (league / tournament) pre-match statistics for soccer in staging — published by Trading on Confluent Cloud (SASL_SSL, API key). Mirrored to Pulsar `competition-prematch-stats`. Payload: JSON with an optional non-JSON byte prefix (RCP's `StatsHandlerDeserializer` skips bytes before the first `{`).

topics.label: Fixture pre-match stats
topics.description: Fixture-level (per-match) pre-match statistics for soccer in staging — published by Trading on Confluent Cloud. Mirrored to Pulsar `fixture-prematch-stats`. Payload: JSON (same handling as competition stats).

topics.label: Soccer gamestate (GCD source)
topics.description: Production source of truth for live soccer game-state — published by Trading on AWS MSK (eu-west-1). The GCD Kafka→Pulsar sink connector reads from here and mirrors to Pulsar `game-state` (use2). Payload: protobuf (gamestate outbound API).

topics.label: Live mappings (Kafka→Pulsar)
topics.description: Production ID/RAMP mapping events on MFSL UKI. The Kafka→Pulsar connector mirrors this to Pulsar `livedata-mappings` (use2). Payload: protobuf (`MappingDeserializer`).

topics.label: Mappings discovery (Pulsar→Kafka)
topics.description: Production discovery feed — Pulsar→Kafka direction. GCD publishes new mapping observations to Pulsar (`mappings-discovery`); the euw1 outbound connector ships them back to MFSL Kafka here.

topics.label: Soccer gamestate (as RCP production reads it)
topics.description: Soccer game-state on the US `use1-mfsfd` cluster — what the deployed RCP production service actually consumes (per `sb-rcpfd-infra/ansible/.../vars/prd.yml`). Mirrored from MSK PRD `trading.soccer.prd.sgt`. Compare against MSK PRD and Pulsar PRD to verify US replication health. Payload: protobuf.

topics.label: Live mappings (as RCP production reads it)
topics.description: Live ID/RAMP mappings on the US `use1-mfsfd` cluster — what the deployed RCP production service consumes (mirrored from MFSL UKI). Payload: protobuf.

topics.label: Competition pre-match stats
topics.description: Production competition-level pre-match statistics on Confluent Cloud (SASL_SSL, API key). Note PRD topic names drop the `nxt.` prefix used in staging. Mirrored to Pulsar `competition-prematch-stats`. Payload: JSON.

topics.label: Fixture pre-match stats
topics.description: Production fixture-level pre-match statistics on Confluent Cloud. Mirrored to Pulsar `fixture-prematch-stats`. Payload: JSON.
